name: Wild Lights at the Detroit Zoo
address: 8450 W. 10 Mile Rd., Royal Oak, MI 48067
when_note: November 27 to 29, December 4 to 6 and December 10 to 23, 2026; 5 to 10:30 PM Friday and Saturday and 5 to 9 PM other nights
cost: $17 to $25 online; $27 at the gate; parking is $8
paras: Wild Lights fills the Detroit Zoo in Royal Oak with Christmas light displays on select nights from November 27 through December 23, 2026. Hours are 5 to 10:30 PM on Fridays and Saturdays and 5 to 9 PM on other nights.
Santa appears on every event night. Tickets are $17 to $25 online and $27 at the gate, and parking costs $8.
tip: Buy online to skip the higher gate price.

name: Holiday Fun and Santa Visits at Maybury Farm
when_note: Saturdays and Sundays December 5, 6, 12 and 13, 2026, 10 AM to 3 PM
cost: $10 per person for everyone age 2 and over; free for children under 2
paras: Maybury Farm in Northville hosts Holiday Fun and Santa Visits on four weekend days in December 2026: December 5, 6, 12 and 13, from 10 AM to 3 PM.
Everyone age 2 and over needs a $10 ticket, and children under 2 get in free. Families visit Santa on the working farm.
tip: Dress for a day outdoors on the farm.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's Livonia
paras: Dave & Buster's in Livonia hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM at 19375 Victor Pkwy.
Tickets start at $27.94, so families can book a breakfast with Santa and then stay for the arcade.
tip: Book early since tickets are sold in advance.

name: Visit with Santa at The Henry Ford Museum
venue: Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation
when_note: November 27 to 29 and December 4 to 6, 2026, 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM and 1:30 to 4 PM
cost: Included with museum admission; free for members
paras: Santa visits the Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation in Dearborn on November 27 to 29 and December 4 to 6, 2026. Visits run from 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM and from 1:30 to 4 PM.
The Santa visit is included with museum admission, and it is free for members.
tip: Plan your Santa visit around the 12:30 PM break.

name: Sensory-Friendly Photos with Santa at the Ford House
address: 1100 Lake Shore Rd., Grosse Pointe Shores, MI 48236
when_note: Wednesdays December 2, 9 and 16, 2 to 3 PM, and Sundays December 6 and 13, 9 to 10 AM, 2026
cost: $25 per child for Ford House friends; $35 per child for the public
ages: Children of all ages who do best in a calm setting
paras: The Edsel and Eleanor Ford House in Grosse Pointe Shores offers Sensory-Friendly Photos with Santa in a quiet, small-group setting. Sessions run on Wednesdays December 2, 9 and 16 from 2 to 3 PM and on Sundays December 6 and 13 from 9 to 10 AM, 2026.
Tickets are $25 per child for Ford House friends and $35 per child for the public, and the tickets are limited. The first session on November 29 sold out, so book early.
tip: Reserve early because tickets are limited.

name: North Pole Express at the Steam Railroading Institute
when_note: Fridays through Sundays December 4 to 6, 11 to 13 and 18 to 20, 2026; trains depart Owosso at 10 AM and 5 PM (show times estimated); sold out at last check
cost: $85 per coach seat; Cocoa Class $250 for 2 seats; children 24 months and under on a lap ride free
paras: The North Pole Express is a pajama-friendly train ride from the Steam Railroading Institute in Owosso. Trains run Fridays through Sundays on December 4 to 6, 11 to 13 and 18 to 20, 2026, departing at 10 AM and 5 PM. The trips were sold out at last check, so watch the official site for returned seats.

Coach Class tickets are $85 per seat and include a cup of hot cocoa. Every ticket also includes free admission to the Village of Ashley Country Christmas and a Believe bell. Children 24 months and under who sit on a lap do not need a ticket.
tip: Check the official site for returned seats because trips are sold out.
